mentions.name: ClaudeVM
mentions.description: A virtual machine concept called ClaudeVM that directly runs literate programs written in Englishscript (English-based programs), eliminating traditional code compilation steps entirely.
mentions.problem: Traditional code compilation steps in programming.
mentions.source_excerpt: Developing this idea of a ClaudeVM and that being the future where we just write literate programs of Englishscript that run directly on the VM and eliminate this code compilation steps entirely.
